The connector now reports errors to the tier's self-hosted Bugsink instance via sentry-sdk: unhandled request exceptions, stdlib `logger.error` events, and failures in every cron/spawned Modal function (each wrapped in `capture_and_reraise`). Reporting is a no-op until the tier's `sentry` Vault entry carries `RSC_SENTRY_DSN`, and can be killed with `MINDS_SENTRY_DISABLED=1`. `sentry-sdk` is now an explicit image pin and the functions attach the new `sentry-<tier>-<deploy_id>` Modal Secret.

`sentry-sdk` is pinned at 2.66.0 (not 2.59.0): sentry-sdk < 2.63.0 re-wraps `dependant.call` in place on every request to a sync FastAPI endpoint served through lazy router inclusion, which killed warm staging connector containers with RecursionError (HTTP 500) after ~990 requests to one endpoint -- `GET /workspaces` died first, breaking client discovery and workspace destroy (mngr-internal#493). A regression test (`test_sentry_wrapper_leak.py`) hammers a sync included route 1500 times with the SDK active.
